maddeler.e:
استرحت (form X)
# اِسْتَرَحْتُ (istaraḥtu) /is.ta.raħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرَاحَ (istarāḥa)
# اِسْتَرَحْتَ (istaraḥta) /is.ta.raħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرَاحَ (istarāḥa)
# اِسْتَرَحْتِ (istaraḥti) /is.ta.raħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرَاحَ (istarāḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
